desc: Parse input; build graph edges i→A_i and reverse adjacency (children lists) for the functional graph.
Identify cycles via Kahn-peeling — unpeeled nodes are cycle nodes; group by walking A.
Per-cycle merged DP: component row = elementwise product of prefix rows of non-cycle children of cycle members; component count = sum_v row(v).
Tree DP via peeling order (children before parents); f_u(v) = ∏ prefix_c(v), prefix via cumsum; direction x_i ≤ x_{A_i} verified.

Implement solve() with numpy ((N+1)×M int64 table ~33MB), Kahn-peel DP, cycle grouping, multiply component answers mod 998244353; pure-Python fallback included; logic verified against samples 1 (6) and 2 (2025).
